1.consolidated_definition: dep. En algunos deportes de pelota, diferencia entre el número de tantos marcados y recibidos. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. Si Puerto Rico gana por uno o dos puntos-¡ adiós boricuas! Como Argentina le ganó a Corea del Sur por seis tantos, de perder por lo menos por dos tantos ante los boricuas, el goal average de los gauchos sería de un +4 (Cancha Local, PR, consultado 11-06-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: In sports involving ball games, the difference between the number of points scored and received is referred to as a "dep." This term is an unadapted Anglicism, commonly used. If Puerto Rico wins by one or two points, it's said that "adiós boricuas!" (goodbye Boricuans!). For example, if Argentina defeats South Korea by six goals, and loses to the Boricuans by at least two goals, the goal average of the Argentines would be a +4.
